biomechanics.interpretation_note: Angles use MediaPipe pose_world_landmarks in estimated meters. The ten-frame peak-wrist window is a fallback when exact foot-contact frames are unavailable. Elbow extension above 15 degrees is only a video screen; it is not an official legality measurement or medical assessment.

ball_physics.note: A ground-plane homography cannot recover airborne ball depth or metric release speed.

Maximum estimated elbow extension: 71.2 degrees. Maximum estimated lateral trunk tilt: 3.9 degrees. The estimated front-knee angle was below the configured screening threshold; review the landing frame. The estimated elbow extension crossed the 15-degree screening threshold; this is not a legality decision. Hip-shoulder separation crossed the configured screening threshold; this is not an injury prediction.
feedback.priority_fix: Prioritize a repeatable, balanced action and review the delivery from the same camera angle before changing mechanics.
feedback.prescribed_net_drill: For the next six deliveries, bowl at comfortable effort while a partner records side-on video; review front-knee position, trunk alignment, and the release frame after each ball.
